instruction: In the tomb of the many columns, the one turned toward the sunrise, which they did not finish: in its hall, at the stair in the corner that goes down and turns back on itself; at its foot: [deposit].
context: Redacted site description: a row of rock-cut tombs in the desert hills on the east side of a river plain, cut for officials of a short-lived royal city. Most were left unfinished when the city was abandoned. The tombs are numbered from north to south.

features.type: rock-cut tomb, façade and entrance only

position.relative_to: north end of the row of tombs

features.opening: façade faces west toward the plain
features.notes: About the middle of the row. Only the façade and entrance were completed; a small area of floor inside; the upper parts of three columns detached as square pillars. Ink inscriptions once on the outer jambs naming a vizier.

features.type: rock-cut tomb with a columned hall

position.relative_to: north end of the row of tombs

features.opening: façade faces west toward the plain
features.notes: South of the middle of the row. Square hall; one row of three columns on each side of the central aisle, partly detached; the long architrave stops at the first column under a cornice; shrines with double cornices at the ends of the cross-corridor.

features.type: rock-cut tomb with a columned hall

position.relative_to: north end of the row of tombs

features.opening: façade faces west toward the plain
features.notes: Near the north end of the row. Single row of four columns, only the two of the aisle decorated; rough second chamber and burial place, perhaps later additions. Façade badly damaged; door found blocked with bricks and stones; a large heap of late pottery outside.

features.type: rock-cut tomb with a columned hall

position.relative_to: north end of the row of tombs

features.opening: façade faces west toward the plain
features.notes: South of the middle of the row. Oblong hall laid out for two rows of four columns; only two detached. A door cornice near the ceiling at the far end of the aisle; royal family scene begun on the outer lintel.

position.relative_to: north end of the row of tombs

features.opening: façade faces west toward the plain
features.notes: South of the middle of the row. Direct-corridor type with a vaulted roof; very incomplete inside and out; a small burial niche high in the south wall; ink figure and prayer in the entrance.

withheld_question: How far below the hall floor does the stair end?
